answer_1.quote: Code summaries are concise natural language descriptions of source code... we propose a novel model CAST... to generate descriptive summaries.

answer_2.quote: we evaluate the performance of our proposed model based on four widely-used metrics, including BLEU, Meteor, Rouge-L and Cider.

answer_4.quote: we also conduct a human evaluation... invite 10 volunteers... assign scores... from the three aspects: similarity... naturalness... and informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: assign scores from 0 to 4 to the generated summary from three aspects: similarity of the generated summary and the ground truth summary, naturalness (grammaticality and fluency), and informativeness (the amount of content carried over from the input code).
